result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical buffers from traffic. The wide roadway and lack of vertical elements like street trees suggest a environment where vehicle speed may be prioritized over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle lights.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection corners appear wide, which can encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and Leading Pedestrian Intervals (LPI).

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and traffic signals, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway width and lack of a pedestrian refuge island or visible pedestrian-specific signals increase exposure and risk for those crossing.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of roadway without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicular traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion regarding crossing phases.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to clearly communicate remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being controlled by traffic lights. The wide, unmarked roadway and poor pavement condition further degrade the environment for people walking in this mixed-use area.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross at this signalized intersection, reducing driver awareness.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has traffic lights for vehicles but no dedicated signals to provide safe crossing intervals for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Poor Road Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt is cracked and uneven, which can be a tripping hazard and indicates a lack of maintenance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
